g.title: Sheet.32
g.desc: HRTIM_CHA1 Set on EEV1 (EEV1 triggers Capture1) Reset on EEV2...
g.text: HRTIM_CHA1Set on EEV1 (EEV1 triggers Capture1)Reset on EEV2EEV1 Blanking on TIMA_CMP1 (avoid frequency run-away)HRTIM_CHB1Set on CMP2 (triggered-half) or EEV1 blanking by TIMA_TA2(TB1 is set if EEV1 occurs between CMP1 and CMP2, else on CMP2)Reset on EEV3HRTIM_CHA2Set on TA_CMP1Reset on TA_CMP2
